notes.title: Major Quality of Life Update v1.23
notes.notes:
Major quality of life update, mostly backend stuff but some new game things.

v1.23

Platforms:
- Windows 64 bit version has been added (32 bit version still available for 32 bit systems)
- Mac 64 bit version, playable on Mac once again
- Linux 64 bit version, no more Linux 32 bit support

Game:
- New music track, the Solar 1 theme
- Updated Mouse controls. Reset the tutorials in the Options menu to see how they work.
- Instant Spawn Menu added to God Options. Unlocks when the game is beaten. Allows you to spawn or shoot objects with the mouse.
- New missions screen that allows you to easily replay any mission.
- Camera now zooms out further with larger systems.
- Slightly improved graphical and audio quality. This is why the game files are larger.

Options:
- Interface scaling, increase or decrease the size of the interface
- Borderless windowed mode added
- Improved menu screens

Backend:
- Data has been moved to "Documents/My Games/Solar2".
- New config file. It contains some advanced options.
- A controls file has been added that allows manual keyboard or controller remapping. Instructions inside the file.
- No external dependencies required. No longer requires XNA to be installed.

notes.title: Space Waif: Solar 2 Is What I Like
notes.notes:
Three wise men once said, “Intergalactic, planetary. Planetary, intergalactic.” I think we all take solace from those words at some points in our life. For are we not all made of star stuff? Solar 2 is built on this species of Saganian wisdom. Coupled with some delightful planetary physics and a dash of good humour, it’s probably the best time you can have alone with a heavenly body. Um. That’s not what I mean. Um. Um.
